weapons.title: Tide trident
weapons.text: A trident: a narrow, long thrust that shoves hard. Its Heavy is a wave slash rolling along the floor that shoves and soaks; its Special a Sweep round you. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.

fire.text: Whatever it hits is set alight, and dried or thawed.

weapons.title: Healing hands
weapons.text: Your hands glow: a Strike heals whoever is in front of you. Hold for the Healing link, which heals the ally under the cursor while it holds; the held Special, Mend, heals the allies around you as you walk slowly. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.

cold.text: Lends its spray: the heal comes out as a cone of cool mist, and puts out whoever it heals if burning. Whoever it heals resists cold, and a little of blows for a few seconds. It never harms.

earth.text: Lends its body: the heal is a lobbed stone that bursts where it lands. Whoever it heals resists blows, and a little fire and cold for a few seconds. It never harms.

fire.text: Lends its spray: the heal comes out as a cone, and dries and thaws whoever it heals. Whoever it heals resists fire and cold for a few seconds. It never harms.

ice.text: Lends its shards: the heal flies as a volley of bright ice shards, each healing whoever it strikes. Whoever it heals resists cold, and a little of blows for a few seconds. It never harms.

lightning.text: Lends its chain: the heal jumps on from ally to ally. Whoever it heals resists lightning for a few seconds. It never harms.

water.text: Lends its push: the spray shoves back the enemies it touches (allies it only heals), and puts out the burning. Whoever it heals resists fire for a few seconds. It never harms.

weapons.title: Frost spear
weapons.text: A long spear with a chilling thrust. Its Heavy is an impaling dash (frozen targets on the way shatter); its Special throws a javelin that pins and frosts. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.

weapons.title: Lightning whip
weapons.text: A long-reach whip that shocks. Its Heavy is a chain lash: the first target, then up to 3 more; its Special a Sweep round you. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.

cold.text: Whatever it hits is chilled, moving and attacking slower the colder it gets, and frozen if it was already wet and cold enough; burning is put out. The spell bursts into a puff of frost where it ends, chilling everything near it (Frost puff).

fire.text: Whatever it hits is set alight, and dried or thawed.

weapons.title: Arcane wand
weapons.text: A wand that shoots light arcane bolts; hold to charge a bolt that pierces. Its Special, Siphon, is held: you stand rooted while your runes regenerate fast. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.

cold.text: Whatever it hits is chilled, moving and attacking slower the colder it gets, and frozen if it was already wet and cold enough; burning is put out. The spell bursts into a puff of frost where it ends, chilling everything near it (Frost puff).

fire.text: Whatever it hits is set alight, and dried or thawed.

ice.text: Whatever it hits is struck hard by ice and chilled a little, and put out if burning; it is frozen if it was already wet. The water is frozen into the spell, so it never soaks. A frozen target shatters from a heavy hit. The spell splits into ice shards on impact, and they fly on (Shatter).

lightning.text: Whatever it hits is shocked and stunned for a moment (a stun breaks a cast or wind-up, but you can still walk). The spell jumps on to a neighbour (Chain).

water.text: Whatever it hits is soaked, put out if burning, and frozen if it was already cold enough. The spell shoves whatever it hits (Push).

weapons.title: Flame sword
weapons.text: A blade that sets alight. Its Heavy is a rolling crescent of flame; its Special a Sweep round you. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.

water.text: Whatever it hits is soaked, put out if burning, and frozen if it was already cold enough. No push: with Fire, the water is steam.

weapons.title: Stone maul
weapons.text: A slow, heavy hammer: every hit knocks down. Its Heavy is a fissure down one lane, knocking down all in it; its Special a Sweep round you. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.

arcane.text: Whatever it hits is exposed: for a moment its wards and resistances don't count, and structures take extra damage. The spell bursts in a small explosion where it lands (Burst).

weapons.title: Ice bow
weapons.text: A bow of ice that looses quick icicles, the fastest shot in hand. Hold to draw a fan of three icicles; a full draw pierces. Its Special is a splinter shot at the cursor that bursts into flying shards. Lasts until it breaks or you conjure another.
